    Given the freshness step has written the stamps for a COMPLETED batch

    Then no ACE table is written

    Given data product "DP01" is fed by one source and has expected-by time 08:00 in Asia/Bangkok
    When its cut-off Temporal Schedule is registered
    Then the Schedule runs at 08:00 with overlap policy SKIP
